title: AI Loan Decisions in Minutes: Is That Real ROI?
audience: Founders, finance executives, lenders, operations leaders and AI implementation teams
hypothesis: A news-led loan-decision example followed by three practical ROI measures will generate qualified attention and subscriber conversion beyond generic AI speed claims.
hookType: Reported real-world speed claim versus measurable ROI
hook: AI loan decisions in minutes do not automatically mean business ROI.
narrativePayoff: Measure time to decision, verified cash effects and exception rates; fictional arithmetic is explicitly labeled.
thumbnailConcept: Simple decision clock versus cash and exception scorecard; no deceptive bank logo or performance claim.
cta: PrismBay AI helps founders, operators and executives implement practical AI business systems.
accuracy: Reuters report is attributed. The 200-case illustration is fictional, not Deutsche Bank results.

experimentDesign.followUpRule: Only test a distinct subsequent hook after reviewing the initial Short. Do not post near duplicates.

thresholds.dataSufficiency: Do not classify performance as a winner until at least five comparable channel Shorts have usable metrics and the candidate has at least 100 views. Otherwise INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
thresholds.scale: At least 30% above comparable channel median on qualified watch time per impression or subscriber conversion, with adequate observations and no accuracy or policy concerns.
thresholds.retest: Weak initial hook with stronger post-hook retention, supported by observed retention data.
thresholds.modify: Early abandonment or audience mismatch established by real metrics.
thresholds.stop: Source error, misleading claims, duplication, policy concern or clear underperformance with adequate observations.

experimentDesign.classificationReason: Metricool returned no video-level metrics or traffic-source rows within 46 minutes of the scheduled release. No scale or stop decision is supported.
